_comment: Cryptarithm locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Keep every {placeholder} exactly as-is; do not translate the assignment token `[A 5]`, single letters, or digits.

_slots.{letter}: A puzzle letter, e.g. S or E
_slots.{used_letter}: The letter that already claimed a digit
_slots.{assigned}: How many letters are mapped so far
_slots.{pct}: Progress as a percentage string, e.g. 50%

player_prompt.intro:
Vakarautaka na kila lekaleka lalai me vaka na lekaleka levu vou me rawa ni caka na arithmetic.
Vakayagataka na [A 5] me veika, se baci veika tale ena gauna cava ga.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Na fomu ni cakacaka ca. Vakayagataka na [A 5].
invalid_move.letter_not_in_puzzle: Na matanivola {letter} e sega ni tiko ena vosavosa.
invalid_move.digit_used: Digit {digit} sa vakayagataki oti mai vei {used_letter}.
invalid_move.leading_zero: Na matanivola e liu ena dua na vosa, me kua ni 0 (zero).

outcome.correct: Sa donu, sa rawati na kena isau.
outcome.incorrect: Sa taucoko na mape, ia e cala na equation.
outcome.limit: Sa yaco na iyalayala ni kena rawa.
